Game Overview

Jack Pumpkin puts players into a ball experience centered on guide Jack, a charming pumpkin, through a gravity-defying world where every twist and turn could reveal hidden pearls. Master strategic movements using intuitive controls and embrace the mystical pumpkin-themed adventure, testing your problem-solving skills as you journey across enchanting rotating landscapes. Can you collect all the pearls and complete your quest?
